evidence_scope: Measurements from the full local simulation that produced the published video. Public-package tests are separate.

model.controller: classical smooth scheduled crawl with joint PD and base feedback

support.method: Time-weighted sums of 30 Hz recorded averaged DEM vertical forces and instantaneous MuJoCo contact-normal forces after startup. Floor is horizontal and kinematic checks find no other pad contact partners. Diagnostic sampled impulse estimate, not high-rate integrated ground truth.

track_diagnostic.method: 4mm raster maximum particle-top surface; visited foot neighborhoods behind final hind feet; same grains before/after
track_diagnostic.limitation: Raster surface metric at finite grain scale; not a calibrated soil deformation measurement.

limitations: Spherical translational grains; no angular grain dynamics, rolling resistance, cohesion or calibrated sand law.
Classical control; no learned policy or model inference.
Passing these checks does not validate real robot performance, soil fidelity, visual quality or equivalence to NVIDIA.
Thin granular bed over a load-bearing rigid substrate. Only footpads exchange DEM forces.
